crime_highlights: Mr. Roper run up behind B.B., grab her from behind tightly around her throat, he then covered her mouth and pulled her towards the front door to the building
he punched her in the right side temple a couple of times
Mr. Roper used his firearm and shot towards the door from north of the entrance alcove to the apartment
Constable Christopherson heard a ringing sound in her right ear and felt a sensation of heat at the top part of her right ear
His behaviour throughout and on June 7 was erratic and sometimes violent, and B.B. was frightened and justifiably so
rationale_highlights: I have regard to some reduced moral blameworthiness on Mr. Roper's part arising out of the Gladue factors and the trauma he suffered as an infant
although that is certainly not conclusive of what must happen here
note: Para 37 is a very long single paragraph; no shorter narrative exists. Dangerous offender, indeterminate.

crime_highlights: Mr. Sellars was the right rear-seat passenger
Mr. Sellars dropped nine rounds of .32-calibre ammunition into the box of the truck
He stated that he bought the Handgun from someone on the street sometime before
He carried the Handgun with him at all times for his protection
rationale_highlights: Mr. Sellars' background has a diminishing effect on his moral blameworthiness
considering the Gladue Factors which are part and parcel of the determination of a fit sentence

crime_highlights: Colton came charging into their home. He grabbed a steak knife from the kitchen table and ran back outside
Colton had stabbed his uncle once in the abdomen
Colton was quickly back on the porch, where he punched another partygoer in the face, punched another man
Colton's uncle died at 9:47 p.m. that night as a result of blood loss from the single knife wound
rationale_highlights: The Smith family of the Lytton First Nation community has been strongly and negatively impacted as a result of the abuses that occurred at St. George's Indian residential school
paying particular attention to your aboriginal background, which clearly played a substantial role in limiting your level of moral blameworthiness
